# Boomin Full Agent Context

Boomin lets customers build creator-program and marketing-distribution infrastructure without rebuilding email OTP, Instagram OAuth, creator approval queues, referral attribution, analytics plumbing, and scoped automation tokens.

## Package

```bash
npm install @boomin/connect @boomin/server
npx @boomin/cli init
npx @boomin/cli handoff init --framework next --auth custom
npx @boomin/cli referral init --framework next --auth custom --write
npx @boomin/cli skill install
npx @boomin/cli mcp install
npx @boomin/cli doctor --json
```

`npx @boomin/cli init` opens a browser login/signup flow, lets the developer select or create a Boomin organization and creator program, ensures a Creator Connect config exists, appends localhost origins, and writes `.env.local`:

```env
VITE_BOOMIN_PUBLIC_KEY=pk_live_...
VITE_BOOMIN_PROGRAM_ID=...
VITE_BOOMIN_API_BASE=https://api.boomin.ai/v1/connect
```

## Browser SDK

```js
import Boomin from "@boomin/connect";

Boomin.init({
  publicKey: import.meta.env.VITE_BOOMIN_PUBLIC_KEY,
  programId: import.meta.env.VITE_BOOMIN_PROGRAM_ID,
  apiBase: import.meta.env.VITE_BOOMIN_API_BASE,
  redirectUri: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname,
});

await Boomin.requestOtp({ email: "creator@example.com", name: "Creator" });
await Boomin.verifyOtp({ email: "creator@example.com", code: "123456" });
await Boomin.connectInstagram({ requireCreator: true });
```

After redirect:

```js
const result = Boomin.consumeRedirectResult();
if (result?.sessionId) {
  const status = await Boomin.getConnectStatus(result.sessionId);
}
```

## Signed Handoff

Use Signed Handoff when the customer app already has a logged-in user.

```js
import { createBoominCreatorJoinHandler } from "@boomin/server/next";

export const GET = createBoominCreatorJoinHandler({
  publicKey: process.env.BOOMIN_CONNECT_PUBLIC_KEY,
  programId: process.env.BOOMIN_CONNECT_PROGRAM_ID,
  redirectUri: process.env.BOOMIN_CONNECT_REDIRECT_URI,
  signingSecret: process.env.BOOMIN_HANDOFF_SIGNING_SECRET,
  issuer: "your-app.com",
  loginUrl: "/login",
  getCurrentUser: async (request) => ({
    externalUserId: "user_123",
    email: "creator@example.com",
    name: "Creator",
    metadata: {},
  }),
});
```

Handoff payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed stable JSON, expire quickly, use one-time nonces, and must target an allowed redirect origin.

## Referral-first install path

When the installer app already has auth, prefer the referral scaffold:

```bash
npx @boomin/cli referral init --framework next --auth clerk --write
npx @boomin/cli doctor
```

## Boomin MCP

Recommended agent install:

```bash
npx @boomin/cli@latest skill install
npx @boomin/cli@latest mcp install
npx @boomin/cli@latest doctor
```

Restart Claude Code or Codex after install so the Boomin skill metadata and MCP server are loaded.

Manual hosted install:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http boomin https://mcp.boomin.ai/mcp
```

OAuth-aware MCP clients can connect directly to `https://mcp.boomin.ai/mcp`. Missing or expired authorization returns a standards-style OAuth challenge that points clients to `https://mcp.boomin.ai/authorize`.

Local stdio install for Codex-style agents:

```bash
npx @boomin/mcp
npx @boomin/cli mcp
```

The CLI `mcp install` path creates a scoped platform token and writes it into Claude Code's user MCP config as a static bearer header. OAuth-aware clients can use the hosted consent flow instead. Both paths map to Boomin platform scopes and audit logs.

Default MCP skill pack:

- `Referral Program Installer`: `boomin.doctor`, `boomin.detect_project`, `boomin.get_connect_config`, `boomin.scaffold_referral_first`, `boomin.verify_referral_install`, `boomin.get_partner_standing`, `boomin.record_test_event`.

Admin opt-in MCP skill pack:

- `Program Operator`: `boomin.get_program`, `boomin.update_program`, `boomin.update_required_channels`, `boomin.update_referral_settings`, requirement CRUD, tier CRUD, and program evaluation.

Program Operator requires explicit scopes such as `programs:update`, `connect_config:write`, `program_requirements:write`, and `program_tiers:write`.

Generated files:
- `app/api/boomin/partner/join/route.js` signs the current app user into Boomin.
- `app/api/boomin/partner/status/route.js` fetches only the current user's standing.
- `app/r/[code]/route.js` records `link_clicks` and redirects with `?ref=<code>`.
- `app/partner/page.jsx` shows referral link, copy button, metrics, approval, qualification, and optional Instagram connect.

Boomin standing responses include:

```json
{
  "referral": { "code": "ABC123", "url": "https://app.example/r/ABC123", "active": true },
  "metrics": { "linkClicks": 0, "signups": 0, "sales": 0, "gmvCents": 0, "productUsage": 0 },
  "approvalStatus": "pending",
  "qualificationStatus": "qualified",
  "requiredChannels": [],
  "missingChannels": []
}
```

Instagram is optional. Referral-only programs use `requiredChannels: []`. Programs that require Instagram return referral data plus `missingChannels: ["instagram"]` until OAuth is complete.

## Public vs private credentials

Public Creator Connect key:
- Prefix: `pk_live_...`
- Browser-safe.
- Starts OTP and Instagram Creator Connect flows.
- Restricted by allowed origins and redirect origins.

Private platform token:
- Prefix: `sk_boomin_live_...`
- Server/agent only.
- Scoped.
- Revocable.
- Has request audit logs.
- Create endpoints are limited to 150 creates/hour per org + token + resource family.

## Platform token commands

```bash
npx @boomin/cli scopes
npx @boomin/cli scopes --json
npx @boomin/cli scopes explain units:create

npx @boomin/cli token create --name "Unit Agent" --scopes org:read,units:read,units:create,units:delete
npx @boomin/cli token list --json
npx @boomin/cli token revoke <token_id>
npx @boomin/cli token rotate <token_id>

npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --read-only --token sk_boomin_live_...
npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --write --cleanup --token sk_boomin_live_...
npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --all-scopes --cleanup --json
```

`platform smoke --all-scopes` creates a temporary all-scope token if no platform token is supplied, executes all registered V1 scopes through `POST /scopes_exec` on `https://api.boomin.ai/v1/platform`, cleans up created smoke objects when `--cleanup` is present, and revokes the temporary token.

## V1 scopes

Setup:
- `org:read`
- `connect_config:read`
- `connect_config:write`

Programs:
- `programs:read`
- `programs:create`
- `programs:update`
- `programs:delete`
- `program_members:read`
- `program_members:approve`
- `program_resources:read`
- `program_resources:write`
- `campaigns:read`
- `campaigns:write`
- `benefits:read`
- `benefits:write`
- `webhooks:read`
- `webhooks:write`

Content:
- `series:read`
- `series:create`
- `series:update`
- `series:delete`
- `units:read`
- `units:create`
- `units:update`
- `units:delete`
- `units:publish`

UI and assets:
- `pages:read`
- `pages:write`
- `pages:delete`
- `canvas:read`
- `canvas:write`
- `canvas:delete`
- `files:read`
- `files:write`
- `files:delete`

Automation and data:
- `agents:read`
- `agents:write`
- `agents:run`
- `workflows:read`
- `workflows:write`
- `workflows:run`
- `contacts:read`
- `segments:read`
- `segments:write`
- `events:read`
- `events:write`

Commerce:
- `commerce:read`
- `commerce:write`

- Docs: https://developers.boomin.ai/api/connect/
- Spec: https://developers.boomin.ai/openapi/connect.yaml

Platform API:
- Docs: https://developers.boomin.ai/api/platform/
- Spec: https://developers.boomin.ai/openapi/platform.yaml

## Product model

Programs are durable. Campaigns are activation pushes inside a program. Program membership owns approval status, referral code, connection status, and billable creator state. Campaigns, benefits, requirements, and webhooks build on top of program membership.
